_header.source: authored by us: assigned by the rule of tools/design_move_effects.py (docs/formats/design_data.md move_effects.json); templates are ROM move INDICES (ids only, no ROM text)
_header.method: tools/design_move_effects.py (deterministic rule: contact / type / area / power band / least-used / index)
_header.notes: DRAFT for review in labs/design. template = ROM move whose scene (effect keys, spawn style, timing) the new move reuses; tint = type colour multiplied onto the effect when the types differ; scale reserved (1.0). Moves with class status / zone / special_effect carry a fallback scene until the status-effect audit.
